name: 60194 · Schaumburg, IL
findings: ZIP 60194 (Schaumburg) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60194 (Schaumburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
